---

You somehow obtained the notebook of a brilliant but eccentric member of your class. The knowledge held within those notes should help you unlock powerful new abilities—if you can ever figure out what the notes mean.

**Benefit and Drawback:** As a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite) activity, you can study the notebook. Make a [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) using your highest [characteristic](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/characteristic) score:

- **≤11:** You summon a hostile demon of your level or lower who attacks you at the end of the [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite). The demon acts first in the combat, regardless of the traits or abilities of you or any other creature involved.
- **12-16:** You learn nothing and your time is wasted.
- **17+:** You learn one [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) [heroic ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/heroic-ability) from your class that you qualify for. You can use that ability until you finish your next [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite).

name: Animal Form
text:
---
benefit: As a maneuver, you take the form of a specific animal of [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) 1T. You retain all your other statistics aside from your [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size), but you can't talk or use actions, and the only maneuvers you can use are [Escape Grab](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.maneuvers/escape-grab), Hide, and Stand Up. Based on the animal you can turn into, you might be able to [burrow](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/burrow) or [fly](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/fly), or to automatically climb or swim at full [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) while moving. drawback: At the start of any [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) while you are [winded](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/winded), the Director can spend 1 Malice to force you to take your [animal form](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/complication/animal-form). name: Antihero
text:
---
benefit: You have 3 [antihero](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/complication/antihero) tokens. Whenever you use an ability or other effect that costs your [Heroic Resource](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/heroic-resource), you can spend 1 [antihero](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/complication/antihero) token in place of 1 [Heroic Resource](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/heroic-resource). Whenever you have fewer than 3 [antihero](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/complication/antihero) tokens and you would earn a [hero token](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/hero-token) for your party through your deeds, you instead regain 1 [antihero](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/complication/antihero) token.
drawback: While you have fewer than 3 [antihero](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/complication/antihero) tokens, you exude a villainous aspect. You and each ally within 5 squares of you take a [bane](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane) on any [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) made to interact with other creatures.
flavor: You used to be a villain. You're (mostly) reformed now, but in desperate moments, you sometimes draw on the rage and hatred that fueled your old life. In those moments, even your friends aren't sure whose side you're on. They don't need to worry, though. Once you leave evil behind, you can't go back. You've made too many enemies on the other side.

name: Artifact Bonded
text:
---
benefit: 'Choose an artifact (see Treasures in Chapter 13: [Rewards](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/chapter/rewards)). The first time in an encounter that you are reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) against your will, the artifact appears on your person. flavor: A powerful artifact has bonded to you, though you don't know whether you're destined to wield the artifact or to destroy it. You're not powerful enough to use it at the moment, although you might be someday. For now, though, the artifact has no effect beyond getting you in trouble.

name: Bereaved
text:
---
benefit: Whenever you don't know what to do, you can appeal to your loved one's spirit for help. You spend a [hero token](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/hero-token) to let the Director determine the next thing you do, whether in or out of combat. The Director chooses the best course of action they can think of for you, even if it relies on information you don't have. If the Director can't think of a particularly good course of action for you to take, you don't spend the [hero token](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/hero-token).
drawback: You have corruption weakness 5.
flavor: The most important person to you—perhaps a family member, mentor, or lover—was killed. The only thing that keeps you going is the faint connection you have with this person's spirit, and the hope that one day you can tie up their unfinished business and let them rest.

name: Lost Your Head
text:
---
benefit: You have the following ability.
drawback: Having no head, you can't see, hear, smell, taste, or verbalize except by using the Share Head ability. Additionally, you can't wear gear that requires a head, such as a helmet or hat.
flavor: 'A bredbeddle stole your head! Usually, being beheaded by one of those magical giants is fatal (see Draw Steel: Monsters), but your latent psionic ability allows you to survive despite your decapitation.'
name: Lost Your Head
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/complication/lost-your-head
type: complication
---

A bredbeddle stole your head! Usually, being beheaded by one of those magical giants is fatal (see *Draw Steel: Monsters*), but your latent psionic ability allows you to survive despite your decapitation.

**Benefit:** You have the following ability.

> ###### Share Head
>
> *You don't have a head, but you can psionically borrow another.*
>
> | **Psionic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)** |                **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
> |---------------------|----------------------------:|
> | **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**    | **🎯 One willing creature** |
>
> **Effect:** You can see, hear, and smell as if you were in the target's space. Additionally, you can borrow their mouth to speak when you wish to do so, speaking in your own voice. This effect ends when you use Share Head on a different target, when the target moves more than 10 squares away from you, or when the target is no longer willing to share their head with you.

**Drawback:** Having no head, you can't see, hear, smell, taste, or verbalize except by using the Share Head ability. Additionally, you can't wear gear that requires a head, such as a helmet or hat.

>

text:
---
benefit: While you are [taunted](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/taunted) by a creature, you gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [strikes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) against that creature. flavor: You're quick to anger, never letting an insult go without slinging one right back. In combat, you fight as if possessed by a literal spirit of wrath. No matter the tactical circumstances, when someone injures you, you feel compelled to answer blood with blood.
